t: Section 10(c) of such Act (7 U.S.C. 2330(c)), is redesignated as section 10(b) and is amended by striking out “the useful arts” and inserting in lieu thereof “plant breeding”.

fable.w: This section only redesignates a subsection of the Plant Variety Protection Act and substitutes the phrase "plant breeding" for "the useful arts." There is no tempting reading: it creates no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with outside parties, rulemaking authority, or right to sue. No party outside the federal government is involved in any federal decision.

qwen_block.w: This section is a technical amendment to a statute, changing the text of a definition or scope from 'the useful arts' to 'plant breeding'. It does not establish any process for public comment, consultation with outside entities, advisory boards, or hearings. It is purely legislative drafting.
qwen_block.s: Section 10(c) of such Act (7 U.S.C. 2330(c)), is redesignated as section 10(b) and is amended by striking out “the useful arts” and inserting in lieu thereof “plant breeding”.
